decisions.statement: Settings arrive as JSON nobody has vouched for.
A toggle with anything other than a boolean is refused.
A key no toggle name has is carried through untouched.
Settings written by a newer temper are still read by an older temper.
A map for characters and a map for companions are both required.
The global scope is left out rather than written empty.
Every toggle name is written out again here.
A name missing from this list is caught where the fields are typed.

definition: what unknown JSON holds to be read as automation settings
